notes.title: Court, Connect, Capture is Available Now!
notes.content:
Court, Connect, Capture is a short mystery and romance story in a fantasy setting that occurs differently with every play through. Make connections, romantic and deductive, in conversations allowing you to capture hearts... and spies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353420/Court_Connect_Capture/

notes.title: Court, Connect, Capture Together
notes.content:
Lets all work together for a complete run of Court, Connect, Capture!
I'll be taking directions from the chat as we play through the game.
Don't worry about spoilers because your experience will probably be different!
